info.title: Abhijeet Shinde Portfolio & Engineering Knowledge API
info.description: Live API providing real-time data for Abhijeet Shinde's portfolio: bio, technical skills, services, work experience, software projects, engineering blogs, and contact messages.

get.summary: Get live bio, technical skills, services, experience, and contact links
get.description: Returns Abhijeet Shinde's up-to-date professional profile, skillset categories (frontend, backend, databases, devops, AI/automation), offered services, experience history, resume URL, and social media profile links.

200.description: Current profile, skills, and experience details

get.summary: Get or search software engineering projects in real-time
get.description: Returns the list of software projects built by Abhijeet. Supports search keywords and filtering by technology stack.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword to search across project names, descriptions, or learnings.

parameters.name: tech
parameters.description: Filter by technology (e.g. Next.js, Docker, Kafka, Supabase, PostgreSQL, React).

get.summary: Fetch live blog posts and technical articles
get.description: Retrieves the latest technical articles directly from Abhijeet's Hashnode publications.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category filter (e.g. 'The Architecture Lab', 'Project Logs', 'Weekly Updates').

post.summary: Send a message or proposal to Abhijeet
post.description: Sends an email message directly to Abhijeet's inbox.
